name: General access problems
definition: Complaints that the user cannot get into the app or account with no clearer cause; not phone-number, password or launch errors.
title: Features fail to load or connect
description: Customers report artist albums and Wrapped not loading, plus connection errors despite working Wi-Fi, even after reinstalling the app.

name: Phone number login errors
definition: Login rejected with check-your-number or cannot-connect messages when using a phone number; not password or social login.
title: Phone number login errors block access
description: Users cannot log in with phone numbers, seeing repeated error messages, and some can only log in on mobile data rather than Wi-Fi.

name: Password and social login failures
definition: Password, email or Facebook login that is rejected or errors; not phone-number login.
title: Password and login credentials rejected
description: Users say correct passwords show as incorrect and login fails after resetting or reinstalling, with some getting persistent errors.

name: Logouts and signup blocks
definition: Being logged out unexpectedly, losing an account, or being unable to create or finish signing up; not repeated login errors.
title: Random logouts and login failures
description: Users are logged out unexpectedly, sometimes while offline, and cannot log back in even after clearing the cache on several devices.

name: App fails to open or connect
definition: App stuck on the splash screen or showing connection or no-internet errors at launch; not playback errors after login.
title: App fails to open or stops working
description: Users say the app won't open or hangs, songs fail to load, and it stops connecting even after updates and reinstalling.

name: General usability problems
definition: Complaints about how the app works or feels that fit no other usability subtopic.
title: Broad loss of basic features
description: Users feel the update removed basic features like queueing, shuffle, loop, and full-song playback, leaving the app much worse.

name: Ad frequency and placement
definition: Too many ads, ads that play after an ad-free window, or ads interrupting listening; not paywall pricing.
title: Frequent ads interrupt listening
description: Listeners find ads too frequent and irrelevant, with several ads played between songs, making free listening frustrating.

name: Shuffle, order and seeking
definition: Forced shuffle, inability to play songs in order, repeat or seek to a part of a track, when not caused by free-tier limits; controls locked to premium go to billing.
title: Skip and replay limits frustrate listeners
description: Users say skip, rewind, repeat, and shuffle controls were limited or removed, often requiring premium, so they cannot choose what plays.

name: Interface and layout changes
definition: Redesigned screens, removed icons, or features moved or hidden after an update; not missing features locked by premium.
title: Removed download, queue, and sorting options
description: After an update, customers say familiar options like queueing, per-song downloads, and sorting disappeared, and they want them restored.

name: General playback problems
definition: Complaints that audio does not play properly with no clearer pattern, including bad quality.
title: Playback glitches and playlists failing
description: Users report songs pausing, queues breaking, audio dropping, and playlists failing to load or save changes.

name: Playback stops or app crashes
definition: Music stops mid-track or after one song, or the app crashes while playing; not slow loading.
title: Music stops playing or app crashes
description: Songs stop automatically after one track or during use, and the app crashes, forcing users to reopen it and restart playback.

name: Buffering and slow loading
definition: Long waits to load lists or start tracks, and buffering or glitching during playback.
title: Slow loading for playlists and search
description: Customers say playlists, podcasts, and search take very long to load, making the app feel sluggish and glitchy.

name: False offline or no-internet errors
definition: App reports no connection or offline status even though the internet works; not launch failures.
title: False no-internet errors on connected devices
description: The app shows no internet connection errors even when Wi-Fi or mobile data works, blocking search and playlist access.

name: Bluetooth, car and watch control
definition: Problems controlling or connecting playback through Bluetooth, car systems or smartwatches.
title: Playback closes or stops unexpectedly
description: Customers say the app closes when used alongside other apps like maps, and songs stop playing, with the cause not tied to Wi-Fi.

name: General download problems
definition: Download complaints that fit no other downloads subtopic.
title: Local files and podcasts won't play
description: Users report local files not playing on Android, downloaded podcasts failing after sleep timers, and songs missing from playlists.

name: Downloads fail to start or save
definition: Songs or podcasts cannot be downloaded at all or stall during download; not deleted after saving.
title: Downloads fail to save on devices
description: Users say songs will not download or stay saved, especially to SD cards on some phones, even after reinstalling the app.

name: Downloads disappear or re-download
definition: Saved downloads are deleted, lost after updates, or downloaded again repeatedly.
title: Downloads disappear after logout or updates
description: Users say downloaded songs are removed after logout or without warning, and downloading a playlist unexpectedly adds songs to favorites.

name: Offline playback needs network
definition: Downloaded content will not play offline or still needs a connection to start; not failure to download.
title: Downloaded music needs internet to play
description: Users say downloaded songs and playlists will not play offline, making paid offline listening pointless when mobile data is off.

name: General catalog gaps
definition: Complaints about the music library or content that fit no other catalog subtopic.
title: Playlists and artist pages fail to load
description: Customers report liked songs, artist albums, and playlists not opening, along with automix playing only a limited set of songs.

name: Recommended and suggested content
definition: Recommended songs, suggested clips or autoplay replacing what the user chose to play; not songs added to the user's own playlists.
title: Autoplay drifts from chosen playlists
description: Users say autoplay switches away from chosen playlists to unwanted similar songs, and recommendations feel poor and mismatched to their taste.

name: Lyrics missing or not loading
definition: Lyrics not shown, failing to load, or lyric features missing; not lyrics locked behind premium.
title: Lyrics fail to load or appear
description: Customers say lyrics never show or show a could-not-load error for many songs, and some note lyrics are often incorrect or absent.

name: Songs or podcasts missing or removed
definition: Specific songs, artists, shows or episodes are absent, unavailable or removed from the catalog.
title: Songs and artists unavailable or disappearing
description: Users find songs marked unavailable, liked tracks vanishing, and artists missing from search, especially in certain regions.

name: Unwanted songs added to playlists
definition: The app adds songs to the user's own playlists without consent; not recommendations shown separately.
title: Unwanted songs added to playlists
description: Users find random artists and songs added to their playlists and liked songs that they did not choose, and want the additions removed.

name: Content bias and policy complaints
definition: Complaints about artist favoritism, controversial hosts, or removal of content for political or policy reasons.
title: Removed music sparks censorship complaints
description: Users object to removed music and artists, calling it censorship, and to unwanted political or news content appearing in their playlists.

name: General billing complaints
definition: Complaints about premium or payment that fit no other billing subtopic.
title: Frequent premium upsell prompts annoy users
description: Users say the app constantly pushes Premium purchases and feels pressuring, and some say they would rather hear ads than pay.

name: Basic features locked behind premium
definition: Features users expected for free, such as lyrics, skipping, choosing songs, queue, seeking or downloading, are locked to premium; not the subscription price itself.
title: Core features moved behind premium paywall
description: Customers say skipping, song choice, and lyrics were moved behind Premium, making the free experience feel downgraded.

name: Premium price too high
definition: Complaints that the premium subscription costs too much for the value; not feature locks.
title: Premium subscription seen as too expensive
description: Many users find Premium costly compared with other services and want cheaper pricing or a free ad-supported option in their region.

name: Charges, purchases and cancellation
definition: Unexpected charges, cancellation not working, or purchase and region errors when buying premium.
title: Payment failures and unexpected charges
description: Users report failed premium purchases, payment method problems, and fees charged without warning, often needing support to resolve them.

name: General support complaints
definition: Complaints about customer support that fit no other support subtopic.
title: Vague dissatisfaction with support and value
description: Scattered remarks say support handled issues poorly and question whether the subscription is worth the money.

name: Unhelpful or rude support replies
definition: Support agents or replies that are unhelpful, scripted, rude or absent.
title: Support replies slow or unhelpful
description: Customers say support emails get no response, troubleshooting does not fix problems, and agent advice has failed to work.

name: Support channels not working
definition: Email, forms or support pages that glitch or cannot be found; not the quality of replies.
title: Phone support removed and hard to reach
description: Users say Spotify no longer offers phone support, and that in-app help and troubleshooting steps are unhelpful or hard to reach.

name: Other
definition: General criticism with no supported specific topic
title: Vague negative feedback about updates
description: Users leave generic complaints about the app and recent updates, often without naming a specific feature or problem.
